# xone (vendored)

`mt76_defs.h` is copied unchanged from
[dlundqvist/xone](https://github.com/dlundqvist/xone) `transport/mt76_defs.h`
at commit `f2aa9fe01103d7600553b505b298ff0bd47ff280`.

It is licensed GPL-2.0-or-later (see `LICENSE` and the file's own header) and is
used here under GPL-3.0-or-later, as that licence permits. It is itself based on
the open-source mt76 driver by Felix Fietkau, Lorenzo Bianconi and Stanislaw
Gruszka.

It builds against the minimal `third_party/compat/linux/types.h`, which provides
the few Linux kernel types and macros it uses.
